answer.reason: Two events in the verses belong to the kingdom of Persia: Cyrus's proclamation and the halting of the temple work.

clauses.english: had its king Cyrus proclaim the rebuilding of the LORD's house at Jerusalem
clauses.quote: he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem

clauses.english: saw the temple work at Jerusalem stopped until the second year of Darius
clauses.quote: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem.

doubts: Other marked verses only name Persia in passing (its kings, its law of the Medes and Persians, its army, visions), so they were left out.
DAN 5:28 gives Babylon's kingdom to the Medes and Persians as an interpretation, not as an event, so it was left out.
